format.compatibility: Unreleased revision-4 prototypes and older writers are rejected; revision-3 migration remains supported. No public C ABI or SDK enum/schema change.

implementation: Move exclusive verified allocator ledger/digest into replacement runtime before index initialization can publish leases. Idle serving caches follow bounded journal suffixes; incompatible anchors use independent reload, and a rebased certificate mismatch forces a fresh full reload.

Seal already-private allocator roots within existing publication/fsync barriers, including allocator-only service. No automatic certificate catalog allocations or self-generating certificate retirement debt.

Publish locked, immutable per-reader data/full-metadata epochs. Every indexed writer fences registration, scans epochs, and bounds retirement before promotion/reuse. Kernel locks recover crashed readers; missing exclusive scan means no promotion. Read-only inode lock authority remains unchanged.
Persist metadata content fingerprints so catalog publication proofs retain owned logical identities rather than long reader pins.

Pool durable immutable artifact sources/block caches by exact inode/value identity across serving replacements; quota-bound stores keep independent accounting. Final close drops marker/resources and queues orphan cleanup without entering writer admission.
Bound background derived windows to 64 records/1 MiB while retaining the primary snapshot required by lazy reads. Keep explicit-drain bounds and oversized-record progress.
Use nonmutating index sync barriers with exact synced-header elision; do not enter allocator transactions for redundant barriers.

Deduplicate document guards within one live publication fence; expose allocator work, blocked reuse, reader-frontier and pending-epoch diagnostics. Benchmark diagnostics are opt-in and collected after timed work.
measurement_notes: Baseline artifact eecf942e88 has identical runtime sources to parent f0e9f6d0c3 (the latter is a receipt/documentation commit). Both fresh databases use their library’s native indexed encoding.
Debug libraries and synced writes on a shared macOS host. Diagnostic results are not production throughput promises.
Matched runs use eight writers, 1024 seeded records and 128 churn keys per writer. File sizes are sampled by OS stat only during timed work.

Primary verification checks the last acknowledged write from each worker plus physical integrity, not every overwritten historical value. Explicit index catch-up, search canary and reopen checks are separate.
